item.title: Judge orders no bond for man accused of killing ex-girlfriend, shooting another woman in Bradenton
item.description: A Manatee County judge ordered Keith Roberts Jr. held without bond Friday during his first court appearance in a deadly shooting that police say has forever altered multiple lives.

item.title: Busch Gardens offering free preschool card to Florida families for limited time
item.description: For a limited time, Florida families can get a free preschool card for unlimited visits to Busch Gardens Tampa Bay and Adventure Island for the whole year.

item.title: Woman dies after riding Revenge of the Mummy attraction at Universal, report says
item.description: A woman died after riding a Universal Orlando attraction in November, a newly released state report says.

item.title: Florida woman punched, kicked ICE officers during immigration operation: DOJ
item.description: A woman was charged with assaulting a federal officer who was conducting an immigration operation in Jacksonville this week.

item.title: Proposed resolution would affirm Sarasota County Schools' collaboration with ICE
item.description: A proposed Sarasota County Schools resolution would affirm the schools’ cooperation with all state and local law enforcement, including ICE.

item.title: Proposal to eliminate property taxes in Florida by 2037 moves forward
item.description: In less than a year, Florida voters could hold all the power when deciding whether to reduce or cut property taxes across the state.

item.title: Riverview woman says crook used her identity to order SIM cards, stuck her with bill
item.description: Sherrie Scarlet said she is the victim of identity theft after being charged for cell phone SIM cards she insists she never ordered.

item.title: Motorcyclist arrested after crash kills pedestrian in Bradenton, police say
item.description: BRADENTON, Fla. (WFLA) — The Bradenton Police Department said a pedestrian was killed after being struck by two vehicles Friday evening. The crash happened near the intersection at Manatee Avenue and 21st Street East when a pedestrian attempted to cross the street. The person was hit by a motorcycle that left the area without stopping. [...]

item.title: 3 dogs found malnourished in Bradenton home cleared for adoption
item.description: Three dogs that were removed from a Bradenton home in October have been approved for future adoption.

item.title: Coast Guard Cutter Alert returns home after seizing more than $18M in drugs
item.description: The crew aboard the Coast Guard cutter Alert returned to their port in Cape Canaveral on Thursday following a 45-day drug patrol.
